Short title, extent and application

ORDINANCE II OF 1973
ORDINANCE II OF
1973
BALUCHISTAN
PROHIBITION OF PUBLIC MEETINGS (ON PUBLIC THOROUGHFARES) ORDINANCE, 1973
An Ordinance to
provide for prohibition of holding of Public Meetings on Public Thoroughfares
in the interest of public order and security
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 13th March 1973]
No. Legis. 1-3/Law/73.---The
following Ordinance by the Governor of Baluchistan is hereby published for
general information :-
1. Short title, extent and
application.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Baluchistan
Prohibition of Public Meetings (on Public Thorough fares) Ordinance, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Province of Baluchistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--For the
purpose of this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or
context-
(a) "District
Magistrate" means the District Magistrate as defined in the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898) :
(b) "meeting" means a
meeting held for the purposes of discussion of matters of public interest, or
for the purpose of expression of views on such matters;
(c) "public meeting"
includes any meeting which the public or any, section thereof are permitted to
attend whether on payment or otherwise;
(d) "public
thoroughfare" means any highway, any public bridge, road, lane, foot-way,
square, Court, alley or passage and includes any open space thereof to which
the public have or are permitted to have access whether on payment or
otherwise;
(e) "promoter" means a
person or class of persons who call, hold, arrange or address a public meeting.

3. Power to prohibit public
meeting on public thoroughfares.---Notwithstanding anything to the contrary
contained in any other law, a District Magistrate may by order prohibit holding
of a public meeting on any thoroughfare.

liable to punishment with imprisonment which may extend to 6 months or fine
which may extend to rupees ,one thousand or both.
